anomalies.description: A sudden burst of white smoke erupts from the lower level near the railing, consistent with a small explosive device or flashbang detonation.
A man in a dark jacket raises a handgun and fires it upward; muzzle flash is visible at 5.5s (f3) and the gun is raised at 5.0s (f2), with the target (a figure on a balcony) visible at 6.0s (f4).

A person on a lower level aims a handgun upward toward a figure on an upper balcony; muzzle flash and smoke are visible at the moment of discharge.; The figure on the upper balcony is struck (recoils backward) immediately after the shot, with visible smoke/flash near them, consistent with being hit by gunfire.
Two men are engaged in close physical struggle: one with long dark hair is being grabbed or struck by another man in a hoodie, with motion blur indicating active combat.

A person with long dark hair appears subdued and possibly helpless while being physically restrained or assaulted by two men in hooded jackets, suggesting an asymmetric attack rather than mutual combat.
